description: Storage blocks: the daily average of a month's samples, the whole 10 GB blocks it needs above the 5 GB included, capped at 20, the charge they come to, the average a month is projected to end on, and the four fifths of an allowance at which a household's owners are first told. Run by @household/domain (storage.test.ts) and by the server's twin (internal/platform/storage, with internal/platform/fairuse's Warns).
sources: PRD 04-billing-and-entitlements §4, FR-BI3: blocks = ceil(max(0, avg_bytes - 5 GB) / 10 GB), charge = blocks x the block price
PRD 04 §4's worked examples: an average of 18 GB is 2 blocks and €2.00; 4 GB is none; 40 GB uploaded and deleted the same day moves a monthly average by about 1.3 GB
PRD 09-decisions D-31 (the daily average, never the peak), D-33 (20 blocks at most, 205 GB) and D-34 (5 GB included, 10 GB blocks)
PRD 04 FR-BI4: the projected month-end average and charge, shown before they are billed
design/v1 household.js blocksFor and its check: a month-to-date average of 18.2 GB and a projected 18.9 GB are 2 blocks each
PRD 04 §4, FR-BI3: the owners are notified at 80 % and at 100 % of what is included; the server's fairuse.Warns counts it in whole numbers, count x 5 >= ceiling x 4, with nothing rounded
